How each board counts

Green days. Counts the days of the season you finished in profit - everything you closed that day, added up. A day only turns green with at least 3 closed trades, so one lucky micro-trade cannot buy a day. You need 10 closed trades in the season, and you must be up on the season overall, to rank. Ties go to the bigger season profit. Days run from the season start in UTC.

Highest ROE. Your best single closed paper trade of the season, by ROE (profit as % of margin). Only trades opened and closed this season count, filled and closed by the server. The ROE must be physically possible for the move and leverage - fabricated numbers are dropped.

Best win rate. At least 20 counted trades closed this season. A win only counts at +5% ROE or better on a real price move (at least 0.2%). Losses always count. Copies count once. Ranking uses a confidence-adjusted score, not the raw percentage - more games at a high win rate beat fewer games at a higher one.

Season XP. All XP earned during the season counts: trading, Academy, missions, duels, streaks, goals. Rewards activity, not position size.

Gold Room. Gold+ members only. A trade closed in profit is +1 point, closed in loss −1. A title, not a payout, until the season of 14 September.

Bybit volume - powered by Bybit. Ranked by the real trading volume you make on Bybit, taken from our affiliate report and loaded a few times a day - nothing you do on MarginPad counts here. Anyone can compete, with one condition: the Bybit account must be opened through MarginPad. Register that account's UID under the board; it is checked against our affiliate list, and one Bybit UID belongs to one MarginPad account. Top 5 share $200: $100, $50, $25, $15, $10 - from the season starting 14 September.

Every board runs per 14-day season and pays the top 5 in real USDT to the rewards balance. Cheating, banned accounts and excluded symbols (forex, metals, indices, stablecoins) never count.

05How a season works

Fourteen days, 00:00 UTC to 00:00 UTCEvery board, the pass, the goals and the calls share one clock. When it ends, the top five on each board are paid, unclaimed pass tiers are granted, and a new season opens.
Nothing here costs money to enterBoards, the free pass track, goals and calls are open to every member. The pro track is the only thing you can buy, and Ticks buy it too.
Everything is measured server-sideRanks, tiers, goals and calls are counted from what the server recorded, never from the browser. What you see here is what pays.
Ticks are mostly earnedCalls, goals and the pass pay Ticks, and the Vault spends them. You can top up with a small pack, but prize money still only moves one way: from the boards to your rewards balance.
